# User controls

```{r user-controls}
# Set this to the location of biomarker_df_with_identifiers_values.csv.
# The script checks these paths in order so it can be run from the project root,
# the script folder, or the folder containing the CSV.
csv_candidates <- c(
  "../data/plotting/biomarker_df_with_identifiers_values.csv",
  "data/plotting/biomarker_df_with_identifiers_values.csv",
  "biomarker_df_with_identifiers_values.csv"
)

csv_path <- csv_candidates[file.exists(csv_candidates)][1]
if (is.na(csv_path)) {
  stop("Could not find biomarker_df_with_identifiers_values.csv. Update csv_candidates in the user-controls chunk.")
}

results_dir <- "../output"
fig_dir     <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
tab_dir     <- file.path(results_dir, "tables")

# If you are running this from a different project structure, switch to local folders:
if (!dir.exists(dirname(results_dir))) {
  results_dir <- "output"
  fig_dir     <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
  tab_dir     <- file.path(results_dir, "tables")
}

dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(tab_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

alpha <- 0.05
p_adjust_method <- "none"  # use "BH" if you want FDR-adjusted significance filtering
reference_site <- "Penn Cove Reference"

measured_metrics <- c("p450", "sod", "shell", "ci")
identifier_cols <- c("latitude", "longitude", "site_number", "reporting_area")
```

# Load data

```{r load-data}
sites <- readr::read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

required_cols <- c(identifier_cols, "site_name", measured_metrics, "ibr_combined")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(sites))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

format_reporting_area <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- as.character(x)
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x_num) ~ x_chr,
    x_num %% 1 == 0 ~ as.character(as.integer(x_num)),
    TRUE ~ as.character(x_num)
  )
}

ra_levels <- sites |>
  distinct(reporting_area) |>
  mutate(
    reporting_area_clean = format_reporting_area(reporting_area),
    reporting_area_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(reporting_area)))
  ) |>
  arrange(reporting_area_num) |>
  pull(reporting_area_clean)

sites <- sites |>
  mutate(
    site_number = as.character(site_number),
    reporting_area = factor(format_reporting_area(reporting_area), levels = ra_levels),
    reporting_area_label = factor(paste0("RA ", reporting_area), levels = paste0("RA ", ra_levels))
  )

# Reporting-area palette: RA 8.1 is the reference reporting area and is set to red/orange.
ra_palette <- c(
  "RA 6"   = "#0072B2",
  "RA 7"   = "#56B4E9",
  "RA 8.1" = "#D55E00",
  "RA 8.2" = "#E69F00",
  "RA 9"   = "#009E73",
  "RA 10"  = "#CC79A7",
  "RA 11"  = "#7F7F7F",
  "RA 12"  = "#F0E442",
  "RA 13"  = "#6A3D9A"
)

# Fallback if the data include an unexpected reporting area.
missing_palette_levels <- setdiff(levels(sites$reporting_area_label), names(ra_palette))
if (length(missing_palette_levels) > 0) {
  extra_cols <- hue_pal()(length(missing_palette_levels))
  ra_palette <- c(ra_palette, setNames(extra_cols, missing_palette_levels))
}

sites |>
  count(reporting_area_label, name = "n_sites")
```

# Plot helpers

```{r plot-helpers}
theme_biomarker <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = rel(0.95))
    )
}

metric_labels <- c(
  p450  = "p450",
  sod   = "SOD",
  shell = "Shell thickness",
  ci    = "Condition index"
)
```

# Figure 1. Four-panel measured metric boxplots

```{r measured-metric-boxplots, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
metrics_long <- sites |>
  select(site_number, site_name, reporting_area_label, all_of(measured_metrics)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(measured_metrics),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    metric_label = factor(metric_labels[metric], levels = metric_labels[measured_metrics])
  )

reference_lines_metrics <- metrics_long |>
  filter(site_name == reference_site) |>
  group_by(metric_label) |>
  summarise(reference_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_measured_metrics <- ggplot(metrics_long, aes(x = reporting_area_label, y = value)) +
  geom_hline(
    data = reference_lines_metrics,
    aes(yintercept = reference_value),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = reporting_area_label), outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65, alpha = 0.78) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = reporting_area_label), width = 0.12, height = 0, alpha = 0.55, size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ra_palette, drop = FALSE, name = "Reporting area") +
  scale_color_manual(values = ra_palette, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Measured biomarker and condition metrics by reporting area",
    subtitle = paste("Dashed line =", reference_site, "value for each metric"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Metric value"
  ) +
  theme_biomarker(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

p_measured_metrics

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "Fig_measured_metrics_4panel_by_reporting_area.png"),
  plot = p_measured_metrics,
  width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 400
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "Fig_measured_metrics_4panel_by_reporting_area.pdf"),
  plot = p_measured_metrics,
  width = 12, height = 8
)
```

```{r ibr-combined-boxplot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.5}
  summarise(reference_value = median(ibr_combined, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(reference_value)

p_ibr_combined <- ggplot(sites, aes(x = reporting_area_label, y = ibr_combined)) +

)
```

# Correlation helpers

```{r correlation-helpers}
run_one_correlation <- function(df, metric_col, comparison_col, method = c("spearman", "kendall")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)

  dat <- df |>
    select(all_of(c(metric_col, comparison_col))) |>
    drop_na()

  if (nrow(dat) < 3 ||
      n_distinct(dat[[metric_col]]) < 2 ||
      n_distinct(dat[[comparison_col]]) < 2) {
    return(tibble(n = nrow(dat), estimate = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
  }

  test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(dat[[metric_col]], dat[[comparison_col]], method = method, exact = FALSE)
  )

  tibble(
    n = nrow(dat),
    estimate = unname(test$estimate),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
}

calc_metric_correlations <- function(df,
                                     target_metrics,
                                     comparison_vars,
                                     method = c("spearman", "kendall"),
                                     alpha = 0.05,
                                     p_adjust_method = "none") {
  method <- match.arg(method)

  crossing(metric = target_metrics, correlated_to = comparison_vars) |>
    filter(metric != correlated_to) |>
    mutate(result = map2(metric, correlated_to, ~ run_one_correlation(df, .x, .y, method = method))) |>
    unnest(result) |>
    mutate(
      method = method,
      coefficient = case_when(
        method == "spearman" ~ "rho",
        method == "kendall"  ~ "tau",
        TRUE ~ "estimate"
      ),
      p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = p_adjust_method),
      significant = !is.na(p_adjusted) & p_adjusted < alpha
    ) |>
    relocate(method, metric, correlated_to, coefficient, estimate, n, p_value, p_adjusted, significant) |>
    arrange(metric, p_adjusted, p_value)
}

make_correlation_gt <- function(sig_df, method_label) {
  if (nrow(sig_df) == 0) {
    sig_df <- tibble(
      metric = character(),
      correlated_to = character(),
      estimate = numeric(),
      n = integer(),
      p_value = numeric(),
      p_adjusted = numeric()
    )
  }

  sig_df |>
    select(metric, correlated_to, estimate, n, p_value, p_adjusted) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(
      title = paste(method_label, "significant correlations"),
      subtitle = paste0("Measured metrics: ", paste(measured_metrics, collapse = ", "),
                        "; alpha = ", alpha,
                        "; p-adjust method = ", p_adjust_method)
    ) |>
    cols_label(
      metric = "Metric",
      correlated_to = "Correlated to",
      estimate = "Effect size",
      n = "n",
      p_value = "p-value",
      p_adjusted = "Adjusted p-value"
    ) |>
    fmt_number(columns = estimate, decimals = 3) |>
    fmt_scientific(columns = c(p_value, p_adjusted), decimals = 3) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
}
```

# Tables. Significant Spearman and Kendall correlations

```{r correlation-tables}
# By default, this compares p450, sod, shell, and ci against every other numeric
# response/index column in the CSV. Identifier columns and the four target metrics
# are excluded from the comparison side to avoid self-correlations and duplicate
# measured-metric pairings.
numeric_cols <- sites |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  names()

comparison_vars <- setdiff(numeric_cols, c(identifier_cols, measured_metrics))

spearman_all <- calc_metric_correlations(
  df = sites,
  target_metrics = measured_metrics,
  comparison_vars = comparison_vars,
  method = "spearman",
  alpha = alpha,
  p_adjust_method = p_adjust_method
)

kendall_all <- calc_metric_correlations(
  df = sites,
  target_metrics = measured_metrics,
  comparison_vars = comparison_vars,
  method = "kendall",
  alpha = alpha,
  p_adjust_method = p_adjust_method
)

spearman_sig <- spearman_all |>
  filter(significant) |>
  arrange(metric, p_adjusted, p_value)

kendall_sig <- kendall_all |>
  filter(significant) |>
  arrange(metric, p_adjusted, p_value)

write_csv(spearman_all, file.path(tab_dir, "Table_spearman_all_metric_correlations.csv"))
write_csv(kendall_all,  file.path(tab_dir, "Table_kendall_all_metric_correlations.csv"))

write_csv(spearman_sig, file.path(tab_dir, "Table_spearman_significant_metric_correlations.csv"))
write_csv(kendall_sig,  file.path(tab_dir, "Table_kendall_significant_metric_correlations.csv"))

spearman_gt <- make_correlation_gt(spearman_sig, "Spearman")
kendall_gt  <- make_correlation_gt(kendall_sig, "Kendall")

gtsave(spearman_gt, file.path(tab_dir, "Table_spearman_significant_metric_correlations.html"))
gtsave(kendall_gt,  file.path(tab_dir, "Table_kendall_significant_metric_correlations.html"))

# PNG table export can fail if webshot2/Chromium is unavailable. The HTML and CSV
# tables above will still be saved.
try(gtsave(spearman_gt, file.path(tab_dir, "Table_spearman_significant_metric_correlations.png")), silent = TRUE)
try(gtsave(kendall_gt,  file.path(tab_dir, "Table_kendall_significant_metric_correlations.png")), silent = TRUE)

spearman_gt
kendall_gt
```
